name: bookworm-cloudflare
description: BookWorm AI 网文创作工作台 · Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Workflows

scripts.dev: npm run build && node scripts/cloudflare-cli.mjs dev --local --port 8787
scripts.db:init:local: node scripts/cloudflare-cli.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/cloudflare-cli.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run build && node scripts/cloudflare-cli.mjs deploy --dry-run
